### What "No Win, No Fee" Means

- **No upfront costs:** You do not pay professional legal fees while your claim is running.
- **Payment on success:** Legal fees are deducted from your final settlement or payout only if your case wins.
- **Disbursements:** These are extra costs like court filing fees or medical reports. Check if your lawyer covers these costs even if you lose, as some firms still require you to pay them.[[1]](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/about-us/fees/)[[2]](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/the-firm/legal-costs/no-win-no-fee)[[3]](https://www.shine.com.au/no-win-no-fee-lawyers)[[4]](https://gordonlegal.com.au/services/no-win-no-fee/)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/lxeSOr_VHGY)[[6]](https://rctlaw.com.au/our-firm/no-win-no-fee-or-expenses/)
